summary: Payments failed because the client TLS certificate used by payment-service to call the external bank-partner-api expired at 12:15:00Z, causing mTLS handshake rejections. The internal error_rate metric stayed low because the failures occurred in downstream calls, not in HTTP responses to clients.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Client TLS certificate expired
ranked_hypotheses.statement: The client certificate used by payment-service to authenticate to bank-partner-api expired at 2026-04-02T12:15:00Z, causing mTLS handshake rejections and payment failures.

causal_chain.claim: cert expiry -> mTLS handshake rejected -> payment marked PENDING_RETRY -> customer sees failure

ranked_hypotheses.title: External bank-partner-api TLS rejection (dependency failure)
ranked_hypotheses.statement: Bank-partner-api rejected connections due to TLS handshake issues, possibly a provider-side certificate problem, leading to payment failures.
assumptions: The error message refers to the remote side, not the client cert.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: Log explicitly states the client certificate expired ("our client cert ... notAfter=2026-04-02T12:15:00Z"), pointing to credential expiry rather than external provider failure.

facts.statement: TLS handshake failures originated from an expired client certificate.
No recent code deployment could have introduced a bug.

timeline.event: First observed mTLS handshake rejection logged.
Support tickets start reporting payment failures.

recommended_actions.action: Rotate/renew the client TLS certificate for payment-service immediately.
recommended_actions.rationale: Restores ability to authenticate to bank-partner-api and stops payment failures.

recommended_actions.action: Add monitoring for certificate expiry (e.g., alert 24h before notAfter).
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents future outages caused by expired credentials.

recommended_actions.action: Verify that downstream error metrics (e.g., bank_api_error_rate) are surfaced on dashboards.
recommended_actions.rationale: Allows operators to see downstream failures earlier.

data_gaps: Exact source and rotation schedule of the expired client certificate (e.g., secret store version) was not queried.
No direct metric for bank-partner-api call failures; adding one would improve observability.

findings.statement: payment-service depends on external bank-partner-api (no telemetry) and on ledger-db and kafka; upstream caller is api-gateway.
First error log at 2026-04-02T12:15:27Z: "payment 45f233b6 marked PENDING_RETRY: mTLS handshake with bank-partner-api rejected"

findings.statement: Repeated log entries show TLS failure: "bank-partner-api call failed: remote error: tls: expired certificate (alert 45); our client cert CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal notAfter=2026-04-02T12:15:00Z"

refs.quote: "bank-partner-api call failed: remote error: tls: expired certificate (alert 45); our client cert CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal notAfter=2026-04-02T12:15:00Z"

findings.statement: No deployments for payment-service between 2026-04-02T10:00:00Z and 2026-04-02T14:00:00Z.
payment-service error_rate metric remained low and stable (avg 0.2‑0.26%) with no spike during the incident window.
A config change at 2026-04-02T11:20:00Z increased bank.api.timeout_ms from 3000 to 5000 ms.
